title: Quaint Russian Pappardelle Pasta
description: A nutty and glassy-jelly nostalgic Russian dish featuring pappardelle pasta, sashimi-cut and satvik-friendly, cooked on a tava-griddle.
instructions: Heat the tava-griddle over medium heat and add the vegetable oil.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the sashimi-cut mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start browning.
Add the chopped walnuts and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pappardelle pasta and stir to combine with the mushroom and walnut mixture.
In a small bowl, mix the powdered agar agar with a little water to make a gel-like paste.
Add the agar agar paste to the pasta mixture and stir to combine.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the pasta is well coated with the sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
